The [posterior](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/bayesian-inference.html#def-posterior) of an unobserved quantity is often too hard to compute.
Variational inference replaces it with a simpler stand-in that is close to it,
where closeness is measured by the [KL divergence](kl-divergence.qmd).
